Business concept

ARTuro (Art + turo, Filipino for “to teach”) guides learners from the ground up.

Mission

To empower beginners and students with clear, jargon-free online courses in web digital media, visual design, and basic programming.

Vision

To be a leading, inclusive learning hub in the Philippines that helps young creators confidently design, build, and bring their ideas to life.

The founders

Hover (or tap) a card to flip it: birthday, zodiac and where to follow.

BSIT 4E · NEUST College of Information and Communications Technology

History

  1. 2018

    Arthur Neri, a 4th-year IT student at NEUST Sumacab, sees classmates struggle with lessons that are too technical or costly, and starts ARTuro.

  2. Growing

    Campus lessons catch on. Arthur listens to learners and adds web design, programming and student-made practical guides.

  3. 2023

    A small school initiative becomes a recognized online learning platform across the country.

Logo design

Secondary logo, dissected into the seven elements that build it. Pinch to zoom in.

How the logo was built, from scratch

Steps 1 to 4 are our own hand sketches, lifted off the paper so you can watch the logo get drawn.

  1. 1

    The letter “A”

    It starts with one rounded, friendly “A”: the foundation everything else grows from.

  2. 2

    Tools form the legs

    A pencil and a paint brush lean together to make the A, with the code tag across the middle.

  3. 3

    Ribbon meets code

    Flowing swooshes and a bar wrap the A, joining art, mentorship and code.

  4. 4

    Wordmark

    The A joins “RTuro” as one wordmark, lettered by hand before it was ever vector.

  5. 5

    Final logo

    Cleaned up as vector and colored in Deep Teal and Orange.

What each element means

Seven pieces, seven points of view. Every part of the mark has a job.

01

Element 01

Letter “A”

The primary foundation of the logo. It’s the first letter of ARTuro and unites every art and technology element into a single mark.

02

Element 02

Pencil

Symbolizes planning and foundation: the starting point of every sketch, wireframe and first draft.

03

Element 03

Paint brush

Represents traditional art, painting and creative visual expression.

04

Element 04

Pen nib

Represents digital design and vector graphics, mirroring the precision tools used in creative software.

05

Element 05

Heart

Directly reflects our tagline, “Code with Heart”: passion, empathy and dedication to learning and teaching.

06

Element 06

Code tags

Represents web development and coding, highlighting the technical foundation of the platform.

07

Element 07

Swooshes

Symbolizes “Turo” (mentorship and guidance) and the smooth flow of knowledge, the bridge that connects art to technology.
